grants.name: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (EHG)
grants.description: Government grant to help lower- and middle-income first-timer families buy their first home.
grants.actionRecommendation: Auto-apply via HDB Flat Portal during flat booking

grants.name: Baby Bonus & Child Development Account (CDA)
grants.agency: Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF)
grants.description: Government matching savings and upfront grants into your child's CDA with OCBC.
grants.actionRecommendation: Pre-open OCBC Child Development Account to receive S$5,000 First Step Grant immediately

grants.name: Climate Friendly Households Programme
grants.description: S$300 in Climate Vouchers for all HDB households to switch to energy/water efficient appliances.

grants.name: Silver Support Scheme
grants.description: Quarterly cash supplement for elderly Singaporeans who had low incomes during working years.
grants.actionRecommendation: Automatic CPF payout assessment for elderly parents

grants.name: GST Voucher Scheme (Cash & MediSave)
grants.description: Annual direct cash and MediSave top-up to offset cost of living for Singaporeans.
grants.actionRecommendation: Check PayNow-NRIC linking for instant disbursement
